basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 27-year-old living in Wellington, New Zealand. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the freedom to explore my creative side while enjoying the stunning landscapes my country has to offer. When I'm not working, I'm either playing MarioMaker2, exploring local hiking trails, or reading up on personal development. I have a complicated relationship with my family, which is why you might find me on the 'narcissisticparents' subreddit. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it provides. I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM, when I wind down with some gaming or Reddit browsing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have spent the last three years building my skills in graphic design through online courses and practical projects. My knowledge of family dynamics and personal development comes from both personal experience and reading extensively on these topics.
